text: Alla Senayee wonanii Mo O Toowi hiMo Suɓoo e Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen Nulaaɓe, hiMo Suɓoo kadi e yimɓe ɓen Nulaaɓe ko wano nii, O Nula yoga e Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen faade e Annabaaɓe ɓen wano Jibriila O Nulii mo faade e Nulaaɓe ɓen immorde e ɓanndinke, hiMo Nula Nulaaɓe jeyaaɓe e ɓanndinke en faade e yimɓe ɓen, pellet, Alla ko O Nanoowo ko sirkooɓe ɓen wowlata kon e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen ko O Humpitiiɗo ɓen ɓe O Suɓii ɗum fii Nulal Makko ngal.
